ceva:1678:dlr.author: Giovanni Ceva
ceva:1678:dlr.work: De lineis rectis se invicem secantibus statica constructio. Ad Serenissimum Ferdinandum Carolum Ducem Mantuae, Montisferrati, Guastallae, &c.
ceva:1678:dlr.locus: Milan: Ex Typographia Ludovici Montiae ([16], 104 pp., 10 folding engraved plates / 85 figures; BNCF Florence copy ita-bnc-mag-00001346-001)
ceva:1678:dlr.note: Editio princeps setting forth Ceva's static-barycentric method: Liber Primus (pp. 1–44, Tab. 1–3, Figs. 1–31: planar & 3D cevian concurrency, Menelaus's theorem, negative weights F - A, Caravaggio Jr.'s Prop. VI, tetrahedron 7-line equilibrium), Liber Secundus (pp. 45–72, Tab. 4–7, Figs. 32–61: circumscribed conics, Gergonne/isotomic conjugates, odd-polygon Ceva), and Appendix Geometrica (pp. 73–104, Tab. 8–10, Figs. 62–85: pure synthetic area proofs, lunes, cylindrical ungula = 2/3 prism, solid centroids, and indivisibles caution). 100% Public Domain.

ceva:1682:opuscula.author: Giovanni Ceva
ceva:1682:opuscula.work: Opuscula mathematica de potentiis obliquis, de pendulis, de vasis, et de fluminibus
ceva:1682:opuscula.note: Extends Ceva's geometric statics to oblique forces, compound pendulums, hydrostatics, and fluvial hydraulics. Public Domain.

ceva:1692:motus.author: Giovanni Ceva
ceva:1692:motus.work: Geometria motus: opusculum geometricum in gratiam aquarum excogitatum
ceva:1692:motus.note: Kinematic and infinitesimal treatise developed during Ceva's Mantuan service. Public Domain.

euclid:elements.author: Euclid of Alexandria (ed. J. L. Heiberg / trans. T. L. Heath)
euclid:elements.work: Stoicheia (Elements), Books I, V, VI, XI, XII
euclid:elements.note: Proportionality of triangles of equal altitude (VI.1), similar triangles (VI.2, VI.4), and compound ratios (VI.23) underlying Caravaggio Jr.'s Prop. VI and Ceva's synthetic Appendix.

archimedes:equipond.author: Archimedes of Syracuse
archimedes:equipond.work: De planorum aequilibriis (On the Equilibrium of Planes), Book I, Props. 4–7
archimedes:equipond.locus: Archimedis Opera Omnia, ed. J. L. Heiberg; Digital Scriptorium geometor/archimedes
archimedes:equipond.note: Establishes the Law of the Lever (commensurable and incommensurable weights balance at distances inversely proportional to their magnitudes, A : B = BF : FA), adopted by Ceva in Liber Primus, Lemmata I–II.

menelaus:sphaerica.author: Menelaus of Alexandria
menelaus:sphaerica.note: Classical collinear transversal theorem re-proved statically by Ceva in Liber Primus, Elementum I and Proposition VIII.

ptolemy:almagest.author: Claudius Ptolemy
ptolemy:almagest.note: Transmits the planar and spherical Menelaus sector configuration in compound-ratio form.

serenus:cylindri.author: Serenus of Antinoöpolis (trans. Federico Commandino)
serenus:cylindri.work: Sereni Antinsensis Philosophi Libri Duo: Unus De Sectione Cylindri, Alter De Sectione Coni
serenus:cylindri.locus: Bologna: Alexander Benacius (appended to Commandino's Apollonius)
serenus:cylindri.note: Demonstrates equivalence of oblique cylindrical sections with Apollonian ellipses; cited by Ceva in Liber Secundus, Lemma I.

pappus:synagoge.author: Pappus of Alexandria (trans. Federico Commandino)
pappus:synagoge.work: Pappi Alexandrini Mathematicae Collectiones, Books VII & VIII
pappus:synagoge.locus: Pesaro: Hieronymus Concordia; Digital Scriptorium geometor/pappus
pappus:synagoge.note: Cross-ratio/harmonic range invariance (Book VII) and centers of gravity (Book VIII).

commandino:1565:centro.author: Federico Commandino
commandino:1565:centro.work: Federici Commandini Urbinatis Liber de centro gravitatis solidorum
commandino:1565:centro.note: Renaissance restoration of Archimedean solid barycenters (parabolic conoid, pyramid/tetrahedron), cited by Ceva.

clavius:1589:euclides.author: Christoph Clavius, S.J.
clavius:1589:euclides.work: Euclidis Elementorum Libri XV: Accessit XVI. de Solidorum Regularium cuiuslibet intra quodlibet comparatione
clavius:1589:euclides.locus: Rome: Apud Bartholomaeum Grassium (2nd rev. ed.)
clavius:1589:euclides.note: Cited by Ceva in Liber Primus on compound-ratio algebra ('ratio composita').

valerio:1604:centro.author: Luca Valerio
valerio:1604:centro.work: De centro gravitatis solidorum libri tres
valerio:1604:centro.note: Rigorous exhaustion-free barycentric determinations of hemispheres and conoids; Ceva praises Valerio as 'subtilissimus nostri aevi Archimedes' in Appendix Geometrica.

cavalieri:1635:indivis.author: Bonaventura Cavalieri, O.S.H.
cavalieri:1635:indivis.work: Geometria indivisibilibus continuorum nova quadam ratione promota
cavalieri:1635:indivis.note: Foundational treatise of planar and solid indivisibles; celebrated in Ceva's Prooemium and critically bounded on curved surfaces at the close of Ceva's Appendix Geometrica.

torricelli:1644:opera.author: Evangelista Torricelli
torricelli:1644:opera.locus: Florence: Typis Amatoris Massae & Laurentii de Landis
torricelli:1644:opera.note: Contains De dimensione parabolae, De solido acuto hyperbolico, and barycentric theorems cited in Ceva's Appendix Geometrica.

borelli:1661:apollonius.author: Giovanni Alfonso Borelli
borelli:1661:apollonius.work: Apollonii Pergaei Conicorum Lib. V, VI, et VII & Archimedis Assumptorum Liber
borelli:1661:apollonius.note: Pisan conic tradition transmitted through Donato Rossetti to Ceva and cited in Liber Secundus, Lemma I.

moebius:1827:barycentr.author: August Ferdinand Möbius
moebius:1827:barycentr.work: Der barycentrische Calcul: ein neues Hülfsmittel zur analytischen Behandlung der Geometrie
moebius:1827:barycentr.locus: Leipzig: Verlag von Johann Ambrosius Barth
moebius:1827:barycentr.note: Systematizes homogeneous barycentric coordinates (u : v : w) of arbitrary sign as a universal projective-affine calculus directly generalizing Ceva's 1678 static weights.

hogendijk:1995:mutaman.author: Jan P. Hogendijk
hogendijk:1995:mutaman.work: Al-Mu'taman ibn Hūd, 11th Century King of Saragossa and Brilliant Mathematician
hogendijk:1995:mutaman.note: Documents the independent 11th-century Arabic synthetic discovery of Ceva's ratio theorem in Kitāb al-Istikmāl.

wildberger:2005:divine.author: Norman J. Wildberger
wildberger:2005:divine.work: Divine Proportions: Rational Trigonometry to Universal Geometry
wildberger:2005:divine.locus: Sydney: Wild Egg; Digital Scriptorium geometor/wildberger
wildberger:2005:divine.note: Establishes radical-free quadrance and vertex-spread invariants underlying Spread Ceva's Theorem in geometor.ceva.
